Harvey Ink audio credits, updated 2026-11-09

assets/midnight-paper.mp3 — "Midnight Paper", an original 20-second
96 BPM loop arranged for electric keys, bass, brushed drums and reed synth.
Composed and rendered for this site. Reference for atmosphere: Balatro's
original soundtrack by LouisF, https://store.steampowered.com/app/2834460/.

assets/harvey-yay.mp3 — "Children Screaming Yay Sound Effect" by Free Sounds
Library, licensed CC BY 4.0. The title cue uses the author's downloadable
recording with a shorter cut, level adjustment and brief fades. Pitch and
formants retain the recorded children's voices.
https://www.freesoundslibrary.com/children-screaming-yay-sound-effect/
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DWqwmIz9vRU
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

assets/jasmine-ink-suite.mp3 — "Jasmine Ink Suite", 36 minutes of quiet sampled
guzheng. Original instrumental arrangement and variations on the traditional
Jiangsu folk melody "Jasmine Flower". Melody reference: Harmony and Keyboard
Improvisation, Tsinghua University Press, p. 10 (unaccompanied melody).
https://www.tup.com.cn/upload/books/yz/085260-01.pdf#page=10
Guzheng pluck sampled from "Chinese Guzheng Single note" by nanliu_music,
Creative Commons Zero 1.0. The sample was tuned and arranged into nine sections.
https://freesound.org/people/nanliu_music/sounds/847157/
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

All audio files are served locally with the site. The rising air sound and the
writing room's two water sounds are generated in the browser.
